objective: Diagnosticar por que el menu Comercial de Preview no carga datos, sin modificar codigo, procesos, SQL, sincronizadores, Tablero Ejecutivo ni Portal de Inteligencia Comercial. Confirmar causa de los errores 403/SIN_ACCESO, Precios Constantes y Reporte PAX antes de cualquier ajuste.

queries.name: ricardo_canonical_identity
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 5 u.UsuarioID, u.Email, u.NombreCompleto, u.Username, ISNULL(u.Activo,1) AS Activo, CONVERT(VARCHAR(36),u.PublicUUID) AS PublicUUID FROM dbo.Usuario_Catalogo AS u WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(u.Email)))='ricardo@edarsa.com.mx' OR UPPER(ISNULL(u.NombreCompleto,'')) LIKE '%RICARDO%BALAM%' ORDER BY u.UsuarioID

queries.name: ricardo_roles
queries.sql: SELECT u.UsuarioID,u.Email,r.RolID,r.CodigoRol,r.NombreRol,ISNULL(r.EsAccesoTotal,0) AS EsAccesoTotal,ISNULL(r.Activo,1) AS RolActivo,ISNULL(ura.Activo,1) AS AsignacionActiva FROM dbo.Usuario_Catalogo AS u WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dbo.Usuario_RolesAsignacion AS ura WITH (NOLOCK) ON ura.UsuarioID=u.UsuarioID LEFT JOIN dbo.Usuario_Roles AS r WITH (NOLOCK) ON r.RolID=ura.RolID WHERE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(u.Email)))='ricardo@edarsa.com.mx' ORDER BY r.CodigoRol

queries.name: ricardo_server_scope
queries.sql: SELECT u.UsuarioID,u.Email,CONVERT(VARCHAR(100),usa.ServidorID) AS ServidorID,ISNULL(usa.Activo,1) AS Activo FROM dbo.Usuario_Catalogo AS u WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dbo.Usuario_ServidoresAsignacion AS usa WITH (NOLOCK) ON usa.UsuarioID=u.UsuarioID AND ISNULL(usa.Activo,1)=1 WHERE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(u.Email)))='ricardo@edarsa.com.mx' ORDER BY ServidorID

queries.name: ricardo_branch_scope
queries.sql: SELECT u.UsuarioID,u.Email,CONVERT(VARCHAR(100),usa.ServidorID) AS ServidorID,CONVERT(VARCHAR(100),usa.SucursalCodigo) AS SucursalCodigo,ISNULL(usa.Activo,1) AS Activo FROM dbo.Usuario_Catalogo AS u WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dbo.Usuario_SucursalesAsignacion AS usa WITH (NOLOCK) ON usa.UsuarioID=u.UsuarioID AND ISNULL(usa.Activo,1)=1 WHERE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(u.Email)))='ricardo@edarsa.com.mx' ORDER BY ServidorID,SucursalCodigo

queries.name: unidad_130_merida
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(100),id) AS UnidadNegocioID,codigo,nombre,CONVERT(VARCHAR(100),server_id) AS ServidorID,CONVERT(VARCHAR(100),sucursal_origen_id) AS SucursalOrigenID,system_type,ISNULL(activo,0) AS Activo FROM dbo.Unidades_Negocio WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE UPPER(ISNULL(nombre,'')) LIKE '%130%MERIDA%' OR UPPER(ISNULL(codigo,'')) LIKE '%130%MID%' ORDER BY nombre

queries.name: ricardo_comercial_permissions
queries.sql: SELECT DISTINCT r.CodigoRol,ISNULL(r.EsAccesoTotal,0) AS EsAccesoTotal,m.CodigoModulo,a.CodigoAccion,ISNULL(prm.Permitido,0) AS Permitido,ISNULL(prm.RestriccionSucursal,0) AS RestriccionSucursal,ISNULL(prm.Activo,1) AS PermisoActivo FROM dbo.Usuario_Catalogo AS u WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.Usuario_RolesAsignacion AS ura WITH (NOLOCK) ON ura.UsuarioID=u.UsuarioID AND ISNULL(ura.Activo,1)=1 INNER JOIN dbo.Usuario_Roles AS r WITH (NOLOCK) ON r.RolID=ura.RolID AND ISNULL(r.Activo,1)=1 INNER JOIN dbo.Usuario_PermisosRolModulo AS prm WITH (NOLOCK) ON prm.RolID=r.RolID INNER JOIN dbo.Usuario_Modulos AS m WITH (NOLOCK) ON m.ModuloID=prm.ModuloID INNER JOIN dbo.Usuario_Acciones AS a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.AccionID=prm.AccionID WHERE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(u.Email)))='ricardo@edarsa.com.mx' AND LOWER(ISNULL(m.CodigoModulo,'')) LIKE '%comercial%' ORDER BY m.CodigoModulo,a.CodigoAccion
